svg.text: A plan to lay out, or
Todo, InProgress or Done. One request closes an
activity and reopens a Done one.
Finish-to-start, and only between activities of this project.
An activity-based project only. Creating an activity is
what brings its board into existence.
Nothing is deleted and no dependency is reconnected.
The result is a graph, not a chain: several activities may
be ready at once. The flag names the predecessor and
clears itself when that predecessor completes. A plan
orders and tracks; it carries no duration, no float and no
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
The state is not among them: it is set by its own request.

No start-to-start, no lag, no overlap, and no edge to
another project's activity. There is one dependency type,
A task needs a board, so declining has no legal
outcome: the gesture is approved or abandoned. The
Activities are flat: finer granularity means more activities,
never sub-activities. A board exists because its owner
The gap an edge leaves is not closed transitively. An
activity is never archived on its own; only its project's
move one along, or reopen it
